properties.name: FIELD REPORT (flo2 F8, 2026-09-18): there is no way to find a skill by describing it — find_tools scores tools only, the corpus and rank ratchet cover tools only, and the owner's own words are on record: 'I continually forget which skills are available'
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md, session 2026-09-18 F8/F9 (triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill, which delivered both feedback rules)
properties.statement: Observation: find_tools located collapse_decision and add_environment_rule by description twice in one session; nothing equivalent exists for 30 skills, so a skill you cannot name is found by reading every description. MEASURED: tools/query.rs find_tools iterates the tool router only; fixtures/find_tools_corpus.json holds one query per TOOL; the ratchet covers tools only; help/SKILL.md sends 'which skills' to list_skills, never to words. PRECEDENT: dec:skills-served moved skills into the binary after find_tools existed. CAUSE: skills joined the served surface without joining the findability discipline the tools already had.
